create.name: Drikung Kyobpa Choling
create.bio:
Drikung Kyobpa Choling is a Tibetan Buddhist meditation centre and temple on a hillside in Escondido, in north San Diego County, California. It was founded in 1996 by the late Drupon Samten Rinpoche with the guidance of His Holiness the Drikung Kyabgön Chetsang, head of the Drikung Kagyu school, and its name honours Kyobpa Jigten Sumgön, the lineage's founder. The richly painted shrine room houses a large Buddha statue, and a stupa of enlightenment is being built in the grounds. Resident and regular teachers include Khenpo Tenzin and Venerable Ani Chodron, a nun who completed the traditional three-year retreat under Drupon Samten Rinpoche.

Most Sundays the community meets for Dharma teaching, meditation and group ritual practice such as Tara, Amitabha or protector practice, often with explanations for newcomers. Senior lamas of the Drikung Kagyu visit for weekend teachings, empowerments and vow ceremonies, which can usually be joined in person or on Zoom for a suggested donation, and a shared vegetarian potluck lunch is part of the day. The centre also holds lama dances and seasonal celebrations, and its YouTube channel shares recorded teachings, some with Spanish subtitles, for a sangha that reaches into Mexico.

courses.title: Mahamudra teachings with Khenchen Konchog Gyaltshen Rinpoche
courses.description: Two weekends of teachings in English on Mahamudra from the writings of Kyobpa Jigten Sumgön, closing with a ceremony to take or renew the bodhisattva vows. Join in person in Escondido or on Zoom; registration required, and no one is turned away for lack of funds.
courses.price: $30 per day in-person, $15 per day for online

free_resources.title: Sunday Dharma programme
free_resources.description: Weekly Sunday gatherings at the temple with teachings, meditation and group practice led by Khenpo Tenzin, Ani Chodron and visiting teachers; the calendar lists each week's topic.
